statements.impact_statement: The advisory is the missing http.MaxBytesReader in the admission webhook handler, knative.dev/pkg/webhook/admission.go:109-117. Easegress reaches knative.dev/pkg only indirectly (go.mod line 382, via knative.dev/serving and knative.dev/client for the FaaS controller) and links API, logging, controller and injection packages of it. Verified with `go list -deps ./cmd/server ./cmd/client` at v2.9.4, v2.10.1 and v2.11.0: 30 knative.dev/pkg packages each, zero under knative.dev/pkg/webhook. The recipe runs the same go list after the build and fails if knative.dev/pkg/webhook is ever linked.
